odran.text: Brother Odran! The dawn keep you. The sick of Millbrook have missed your hands.

greet.text: Welcome to the Temple of the Dawn. How may the light serve you?

options.text: Is there anything the temple needs?
We've brought a lantern for the altar.

quest.text: Our altar lamp cracked in the frost, and a temple of the dawn without a light is a poor joke. If you could find a hooded lantern, Tobin at the inn sells them, I would be grateful, and so would the dawn.

raised.text: Breathe, child. The dawn is not finished with you yet.

poor.text: The temple asks only a small offering for its work, and I'm afraid I can't make exceptions. The roof leaks in three places.

blessed.text: It burns beautifully. Take this, with the blessing of the dawn.
